recognize_zh: 這是一張 G-banding 染色體核型圖（female, XX），紅色箭頭標出第 3（第三條拷貝）、7、11（兩處）、13 號染色體的異常，屬於多重結構與數目異常的複雜核型，符合 ATLL 常見的核型表現。
features: Two X chromosomes, consistent with a female karyotype
Apparently three copies of chromosome 3, one marked by an arrow (possible trisomy 3 or derivative)
Arrows on one chromosome 7 (distal end), one chromosome 11 (two bands in the long arm region) and one chromosome 13 (terminal end), indicating structural abnormalities
Band resolution is modest, so exact breakpoints cannot be assigned from this image
describe_en: A G-banded karyogram from a female patient is shown. Arrows highlight an apparent extra copy of chromosome 3 and structural abnormalities involving chromosomes 7, 11 (two marked sites) and 13. Together these constitute a complex abnormal karyotype. Exact breakpoints cannot be reliably defined at this banding resolution. In the context of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, a complex karyotype with numerical and structural changes, including gains of chromosome 3, is a recognized pattern.
